steps: Open the V380 Pro mobile app and go into the camera's settings.
Find the ONVIF section and turn the switch on.
Leave the port at its default, 8899.
Set an ONVIF username and password. These are separate credentials, not your cloud account password. The username is usually admin.
If there is a separate RTSP switch next to it, turn that on as well.
Save, then reboot the camera: cut the power for 10 seconds. Without a reboot the setting does not take effect.
Wait a minute and check: ports 554 and 8899 should now be open.

security.notes: The RTSP server serves video with no authentication at all: anyone on the local network can watch it if they know the path. Do not forward ports 554 and 8899 to the internet. Use a VPN to reach the camera from another network.

notes: ONVIF is implemented fully: Media, PTZ, Imaging and Events. Continuous and absolute positioning, zoom and presets all work. The serial number in the ONVIF response is fake (123456789) and useless for identification. GetStreamUri returns the stream address without a port number — port 554 has to be filled in by the client.
